title: UI composition patterns on both lanes: a form bound to a record and a searchable dropdown (library block); their widgets, events and instances are stated per role in ui.input, ui.event and ui.block-instance

capabilities.title: Form bound to a record: edit its fields and save
capabilities.summary: Screen input (Id), IScreenAggregate filtered by it, IForm with IInput/ICheckbox bound to `GetX.List.Current.<Entity>.<Attr>`, a Save button whose screen action calls the save wrapper of front A that runs CreateOrUpdate<Entity>.

route.operation: screen-form.json pattern: wrapper server action + screen + aggregate + IForm + inputs + IScreenAction + set $btn/OnClick Destination

depends.unless: the entity already exists (bind the form to IServerEntity:Name; its attributes are in context.signatures)
a save wrapper action for that entity already exists (call it from the screen action)
the screen already exists (add the form under IMobileScreen:Name/...; ui.edit)

recommends.when: the module already exists: read its entities, screens and referenced blocks (--app) before declaring new ones
the fields need other value widgets (switch, text area, radio, upload) or their per-role evidence

alternatives.when: the archetype form (kind form) is acceptable: fields input|textarea|checkbox only, no dropdown field

capabilities.guidance: For a selectable field inside the form combine with ui.dropdown (native) or ui.dropdown-search (library block, read its contract from the capture). The widgets of the form are ui.input roles, the Save button's OnClick is a ui.event binding, and the save logic belongs to the logic capabilities.

limits.text: Mandatory comes from the attribute or `set Mandatory True`; the screen must not call the entity action directly (wrapper server action).

Same pattern on O11 Reactive: screen input ContactId, filtered aggregate, Form with inputs bound to the record, button OnClick -> screen action Save -> server action wrapper Contact_Save -> CreateOrUpdateContact. Traditional Web forms use the web widgets and the Preparation (ui.traditional-screen, ui.traditional-widget).

differences: a button's caption sits beside the button (not inside IContent)

capabilities.title: Searchable dropdown (OutSystemsUI DropdownSearch block)
capabilities.summary: An instance of the OutSystemsUI block DropdownSearch referenced by the module. Its inputs, mandatory input types and events (with their parameters) are the signature of the referenced revision: read them from the capture (`--app`: context.signatures, D), never from this text. Instantiate with the visual `html` op (`<Block name="DropdownSearch" :<Input>="expr" @<Event>="ScreenAction">`) or the raw verbs (`create IMobileBlockInstanceWidget` with source `IMobileBlock:DropdownSearch`, `set $b/<Input> Value`, `set $b/<Event> Handler $action`); the handler of the selection event assigns the selection to the record field.

route.operation: html-visual `<Block>` or raw verbs on IMobileBlockInstanceWidget; a screen action builds the option list expected by the block input from an aggregate and another handles the selection event

depends.unless: the screen already exists (place the instance under IMobileScreen:Name/...)
a screen action to handle the mandatory event already exists (set $b/<Event> Handler to it)

recommends.when: the per-role statements of a block instance: arguments, handlers, placeholder content, the referenced signature (read-only)

alternatives.when: no typing/search is needed: the native IDropdown binds a record field directly

capabilities.guidance: Build the option list expected by the block input (type in context.signatures) in a screen action or data action from the entity list, keep it in a screen variable, and map the event's selection parameter back to the FK in the handler.

limits.text: No ODC job instantiates DropdownSearch; the nearest ODC proofs are html-visual-block (DatePicker block with input and mandatory handler) and block-events (event handlers). The offline block doc is O11 OutSystemsUI 2.28.1 and is not used by the answer; on ODC the contract is the MobileBlockSignature in the capture (context.signatures with --app, or `odc inspect <capture> "MobileBlockSignature:DropdownSearch" --depth 2`).

A block instance has no Variable of its own: the selected value only reaches the record through the handler of the block's selection event; a mandatory event without handler is a Verify error per instance (EventHandlerRequiredAction).

No O11 suite job instantiates DropdownSearch; the O11 proofs of OutSystemsUI instances with handlers are osui-patterns (Tabs OnTabChange) and osui-datepicker-handler (DatePicker OnSelected) in ui.block-instance. The offline OutSystemsUI 2.28.1 catalog is not used by jobs nor by this answer: the contract is the MobileBlockSignature in the module.
